**Daily Devotional**

**April 6**

*14 Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place. (2 Corinthians 2:14 KJV)*

The Greek word THRIAMBEUO that is used in this verse as “causeth us to triumph”, is referring to the triumphant parade where Jesus made a show of Satan when He defeated him (Colossians 2:15). This is saying that us Christians saw the parade that displayed Satan as a defeated foe, and was cast out of heaven (Revelation 12:7-9). Our web page “New Revelations” on our web site has more on the defeat of Satan. It is just telling us that we have been victorious over Satan and his demons, and as Christians we have the power to rebuke and send the devil on his way when he comes at us (James 4:7).

This does not mean the devil won’t give us trouble, as all who serve the Lord will suffer persecution (2 Timothy 3:12), but as Christians we do have power over the devil and his demons. The only power that Satan has, is when a creature with a body, gives in to the devil, and lets the devil use their body to do harm. Other than that, the devil can only use his lies and deceit to make us destroy ourselves, and he is good at that. God does not bring condemnation upon the Christian (Romans 8:1), but the devil will, ever chance he gets. Walk close with the Lord and you won’t give the devil an opportunity to harm you. Praise God for giving us power over the devil.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
